interaction_scope: Native tree-row Windows mouse-message dispatch opens the real parameter editor; native Apply BM_CLICK starts timing. Normal expected_revision doc_apply, Studio progress worker/message pump, journal publication and display-scene rebuild finish the authoring stage. Final drawFrame submission and SwapBuffers API return are timed separately.
timing_limits: Hidden Studio window/OpenGL context, requested swap interval 0. Automated dialog input and its 200ms timer dwell are excluded from Apply latency and recorded separately. No physical input-device latency, OS-cold cache, GPU completion, compositor presentation, monitor scanout or native OCCT workload qualification is claimed. No percentile is a performance acceptance threshold.
model_scope: Independent legacy analytic box definitions, explicit driver expressions and one translated occurrence per definition; display meshes are generated from those analytic definitions.
scope: Final native Windows synthetic Apply-through-SwapBuffers observations; absolute runtime/fixture/capture paths excluded. Physical input, GPU completion, scanout, OS-cold and OCCT-workload latency remain unqualified.
